auth.notes: OAuth 2.0 with Authorization Code and Client Credentials grant types. Bearer token authentication in HTTP requests.

evidence.snippet: OAuth grant type selection. The grant type determines how your app authenticates and acquires authorization to access protected resources.
Build a working authentication flow based on OAuth 2. The basic flow is as follows: Make an authorization request to our OAuth page in your browser.

access.notes: Trial access is free but requires Pinterest app review. Standard production access requires additional approval with video demo of OAuth flow implementation.

evidence.snippet: Application requests are reviewed by Pinterest. You will receive an email notification after your app has been reviewed, letting you know whether it was approved or denied access.
To ensure your app gets approved for Standard access make sure to prep the following: Prepare a video recording of your app completing an action using the Pinterest API.
Our sandbox environment allows you to make test calls without impacting the Pinterest product environment.
